detail: No sections (My tools / Add more / Beta / Coming soon / Bundles); catalogue cards lack plan, cycle, price per period, seats, renewal date and usage bars (on /billing instead); no Manage seats, Restore or Send feedback.

title: USR-07: Change plan / seats
detail: No seats input; summary lacks current -> new, effective date and next renewal amount; downgrade has no over-limit data list or confirm checkbox; scheduled downgrade never applied by the mock; workspace-private plans not offered.

title: USR-09: Cart & checkout
detail: One cart line only (no remove, no seats); billing section is just the legal name (no email, country, address, tax ID); no 'Charged in X' with next renewal date and amount; no save-card or accept-terms checkboxes; methods not routed; changing billing country isn't possible here.

title: USR-10: Payment result
detail: No Pending state (Fawry/bank reference, expiry); the invoice link goes to the list, not an AR/EN invoice; 'Use another method' is implicit.

title: USR-11: Billing overview
detail: No next-payment widget (date, amount, method), no credit balance, no default payment method or billing details summary.

title: USR-12: Invoices
detail: No type or description columns, no AR/EN download, no Pay on open invoices, no filters (type, status, date range).

title: USR-13: Payment methods
detail: No expiring-card warning 30 days before expiry.

title: USR-14: Billing details
detail: No city/postal code fields; no tax-ID format check; country stays a select after the first payment (it queues a support migration) rather than read-only with 'Moved country? Contact support'.

title: USR-15: Cancel & refund
detail: No stepped flow: no refund eligibility/estimate, reason is free text (no select), no refund toggle creating a ticket, no retention offer, no password for the whole workspace.

title: USR-16: My Services
detail: Shows created, not updated; empty state is text only, not a catalogue preview with 'Request a service'.

title: USR-17: New service request
detail: No category, attachments, preferred contact, phone or 'pre-filled from' project; description minimum 20 (spec 30); budget is an amount, not ranges.

title: USR-18: Quote view
detail: No version, tax, payment terms, milestone amounts, revisions included or PDF; Accept -> pay full only (no first milestone).

title: USR-19: Service project page
detail: No tabs (Files, Revisions, Invoices), no status timeline, revision has no deliverable select or attachments, no revision counter, no Pay milestone, no Rate.

title: USR-20: Team
detail: No last active, no Deactivated status, no resend invite, deactivate, remove with reassignment or transfer ownership; invite takes one email (spec up to 20), no guest scope or personal message.

title: USR-22: Company settings (General)
detail: Only the name (one language) is editable: no logo, default language, time zone, date format/week start, read-only currency, require 2FA or departments.

title: USR-23: My profile & security
detail: No phone, no email change with verification, no 2FA with backup codes, no sessions list.

title: USR-24: Notifications
detail: No filter by tool; no preferences matrix; no locked billing/security emails.

title: USR-25: Support tickets
detail: Form lacks related tool, related invoice/request, priority and attachments; categories differ (no Service).

title: USR-27: Data & privacy
detail: No export, no Leave workspace for non-owners, no Delete my account, no password on delete, no recovery action within 30 days.

title: F-01: Pricing display & currency detection
detail: Steps 1-2 and 4 (pricing page with IP country and a country change) don't exist on the website; step 5 only in-app; step 6 'Prices updated for <country>' notice absent.

title: F-02: Sign-up & onboarding
detail: No email verification; no USR-04 steps (workspace form, pick tools, invite); no Home setup checklist or welcome email.

title: F-03: Checkout & first payment (currency lock)
detail: No billing details step beyond legal name, no routed methods or 3-D Secure, no pending (Fawry) branch, no e-invoice, no receipt email.

title: F-04: Trial lifecycle
detail: No -3/-1 day email and in-app reminders (banner only); no 'activate at trial end' choice; no deletion warning email 7 days before.

title: F-05: Upgrade, downgrade, remove tool
detail: Upgrade restarts the period (period end not kept); no seat changes; no read-only warning confirm; scheduled downgrade never applied (no lifecycle handler); no Restore; no cross-tool 'unavailable'.

title: F-06: Renewal & failed payment (dunning)
detail: No reminders or pay links; no renewal-day invoice/charge (active lines never renew or fail in the mock); no retries on days 1/3/5; no emails; at day 37 lines end but the workspace isn't set Cancelled.

title: F-08: Country moves zone / currency changes
detail: Step 2 impact screen missing; step 4: moving a country or overriding currency queues no migration and there is no 'needs currency migration' filter; step 5: no owner notice and approved migrations never apply at renewal.

title: F-09: Service request lifecycle
detail: No milestone payments (customer pays the full quote); no revision counter; no notifications to customer/team; no rating or portfolio consent; team assignment is a single person and not tied to 'after payment'.

title: F-10: Refund
detail: Step 1: owner can't request a refund (cancel takes only a reason, no eligibility); step 2: policy rule not shown; step 3: no cancel-line option; step 4: no gateway refund or AR/EN credit-note PDF; step 5: no notification.

title: F-11: Tool release: Coming Soon → Beta → Available
detail: No expected date; no open/invite-only beta or invites; no launch settings (billing start, coupon, message); beta users aren't moved to a plan/Free at billing start; no launch email or in-app notice (only a notified flag).

title: ST-subscription-line-per-tool: Subscription line (per tool)
detail: Active -> Past due on a failed renewal never happens at runtime (no renewal step; only seeded data and checkout declines); Ended -> Active (restore) missing; scheduled changes (downgrade, price change) never applied at period end.

title: ST-invoice: Invoice
detail: Open -> Past due when the due date passes is not automatic (only a failed retry sets past_due).

title: ST-workspace: Workspace
detail: Cancelled -> Deleted after retention never happens (deleteAt is set but not processed); dunning never cancels a workspace (only lines end).
